name: SF Welcome
description: Salesforce-branded splash screen with environment status, release freshness, and community info

docs.summary: Non-blocking startup header with model/environment status, one-line LSP and Herdr readiness, optional gateway usage, release freshness, announcements, recommended extensions, and recent sessions. SF Welcome mode is independent from Pi's native quietStartup setting; /sf-welcome and /sf-setup-fonts remain available on demand.
